title: How Newton’s Apple Changed Science Forever
description:
Everyone has heard of the story of Newton and the apple, but did an apple really fall on his head? While that part is an urban legend, the real story is far more fascinating.

What makes Newton special isn’t that he thought the Earth attracts an apple — anyone could guess that. His genius was realizing that the apple also attracts the Earth with equal force. This insight, expressed in the law of universal gravitation, showed that every object with mass pulls on every other object with mass.

Newton extended this idea beyond apples: gravity explains why the Moon orbits the Earth and why the Earth orbits the Sun. From a simple falling apple, Newton uncovered the force that governs the cosmos.

If you’ve searched for “Newton apple story,” “gravity discovered by Newton,” “law of universal gravitation explained,” “apple fall Newton myth,” “Newton apple truth,” “moon orbit gravity,” “earth orbit sun gravity,” or “Newton genius gravity story”, this video gives you the rational perspective.
